idea.title: Idea: WatchTower Lite (pricing-change radar) for SMB SaaS
bullets: Track competitor pricing + packaging pages weekly; alert on meaningful diffs (not noise).
Auto-generate 3 sales talk-tracks + 2 marketing response angles per change.
Sell as subscription “don’t get blindsided” (not a tool).

momentum: Pick one metric to move today; ignore the rest.
Ship the smallest thing that creates a new constraint.
If it can't be tested this week, it's not real yet.
If it's fuzzy, write it down.
One outreach message > ten strategy notes.
Build what you can sell, not what you can explain.
actions: Pick 1 WatchTower niche + lock Starter/Pro pricing (sell one pilot this week).
Send 10 targeted outbound messages (tight list) — get 2 replies.
